snippet.title: Livber: Smoke And Mirrors | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
A short psychological horror interactive story. Five years after vanishing without a trace, the woman you once called your lover writes from beyond the silence: "I will give birth to our creation.” In three acts, descend into a fractured mindscape where obsession, memory, and myth intertwine.
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
